senses.en_definition: A masculine given name, normally capitalized Ralph.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang biasanya dieja dengan huruf awal besar, Ralph.

etymology.historical_story: Ralph developed from older Germanic personal names, including the Old Norse Ráðúlfr and Norman Radulf. Scandinavian settlement and Norman influence helped establish the name in England. Medieval spellings included Rauf, Rafe and Ralf. Its different modern pronunciations preserve aspects of that history; none provides evidence that Ralph is an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. Source: [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ralph).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 马来西亚职场中可按本人偏好使用姓名及适当称谓；Encik Ralph 是示例，并非所有场合都必须加 Encik。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式文件保留本人姓名的拼写和大小写，不把专名强行翻译成普通词义，也不根据姓名推断国籍、族群或宗教。
